templates.why_chosen: A spatial PE-mesh floorplan: PEs are addressed by grid coordinates (PE[0,0], PE[1,0]), each row fed by its own FSM orchestrator, and a msg arrow between rows shows one instruction issue changing at runtime.
templates.what_to_learn: Address processing elements by literal grid coordinates (PE[row,col]) so position doubles as a label, and when a mechanism is really about timing, annotate it directly on the mesh with a small '+N cycles' tag and a cross-row message arrow instead of adding a separate timeline.
